column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key identifying each supplies record (e.g., 'SUP0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry) to link supplies to an event (e.g., 'DIST0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing DistributionHubs(HubRegistry), tying supplies to a particular hub (e.g., 'HUB0001').

JSONB column. Provides a comprehensive view of all supply resources available for disaster response, including food, water, shelter, medical, and power-related supplies.
Fields: {"essentials":{"food_tons":"A DECIMAL(11,3) denoting the quantity of food in tons (e.g., 12.500).","water_liters":"A NUMERIC(12,3) specifying the water supply in liters (e.g., 25000.000)."},"hygiene_kits":"An INT measuring the quantity of hygiene kits (e.g., 300).","medical":"An INT counting medical supply units (e.g., 500).","power":{"fuel_liters":"A DECIMAL(9,1) specifying the liters of fuel reserve (e.g., 5000.0).","generators":"An INT for how many power generators are available (e.g., 10)."},"shelter":{"blankets":"An INTEGER storing the total number of blankets (e.g., 1000).","units":"An INT showing how many shelter kits or tents (e.g., 200)."}}
